request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, soft strings, moderate tempo 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sons of Judah, line by line
Er, Onan, and Shelah shine
Bath-shua gave these three
The firstborn Er was not seen
By the Lord with favor, no
His path ended, it is so
Tamar bore Perez and Zerah
Judah had five sons, no fear

[Verse]
Perez gave Hezron, Hamul
Hezron's firstborn, Ram the full
Bunah, Oren, Ozem, Ahijah
Ram's sons: Maaz, Jamin, Eker
Jerahmeel had Atarah too
She was Onam's mother, true
Shammai and Jada, Onam's seed
Nadab and Abishur, indeed

[Pre-Chorus]
Abishur's wife, Abihail
Bore Ahban and Molid, faithful
Nadab's sons, two names here
Seled and Appaim, so clear

[Chorus]
Seled died without children
His line stopped, his story ended
Appaim walked on ahead
Ishi, Sheshan, Ahlai fed
A record kept in Chronicles
Names preserved, not forgotten

[Verse]
Jerahmeel's clan, Judah's part
History after the exile's art
Who lived, who died, who stayed
The genealogy, the weight
Seled's life, briefly known
Without children, alone
But the book holds his name
In the tribe, same as flame

[Chorus]
Seled died without children
His line stopped, his story ended
Appaim walked on ahead
Ishi, Sheshan, Ahlai fed
A record kept in Chronicles
Names preserved, not forgotten

[Outro]
Seled died without children
Remembered in the text
